title: New Balance Unveil The Fresh Foam BB That Bulls' G Zach LaVine Wore Against The Pistons
htmlContent:
Today, New Balance will unveil the Fresh Foam BB worn by Chicago Bulls Guard Zach LaVine when he takes the court against the Detroit Pistons in Paris. The Fresh Foam BB is the newest addition to the brands basketball portfolio and its midsole features the award-winning Fresh Foam technology.

The Fresh Foam BB limited edition ‘Paris’ colorway will be available exclusively at
www.NewBalance.com starting January 20th with the suggested retail price of $130.

The second and global launch colorway, called ‘Virtual’ will be available at www.NewBalance.com and select retailers starting February 3rd with additional colorways that will launch throughout the season.

“I have been working with the New Balance design team on this launch since I first joined the brand,
so I am really excited to be able to talk about it and wear it on court,” says New Balance Athlete and
Two-Time NBA All Star Zach LaVine. “The feel of this shoe is incredible.

The combination of the soft ride with the right mix of stability allows me to focus on my game while my feet stay fresh.” New Balance designers used the latest advancements in data-to-design to deliver precisely tuned cushioning underfoot, ideal for players who want to effortlessly play both ends of the court. Fresh Foam delivers a cushioned ride and the TPU cage on the lateral side adds stability to allow for sharp cuts on the court. A seamless lightweight one-piece FitWeave upper provides 360 degrees of
support and comfort.

“With the addition of the new Fresh Foam BB to our hoops line, we now offer innovative comfort and
performance for every style of play,” says Trent Casper New Balance General Manager for
Performance Basketball.

“The Fresh Foam BB gives players optimal cushioning with a smooth heal
to toe transition. We continue to design for the position less player and the Fresh Foam BB gives
athletes another on-court option that will help keep their feet fresh in the fourth.”

The limited-edition Fresh Foam BB ‘Paris’ is inspired by the charming, colorful aesthetics found in
the architecture of the Rue Cremieux featuring bold, bright colors found on the popular street. The
Fresh Foam BB ‘Virtual’ draws its inspiration from the digital extension of the game and the love
players have both on the physical court and the digital one, bringing pops of blue, red and yellow.
For more information please visit www.newbalance.com/basketball.
